name: Exage aero brake lever pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed: pair of standard BL-A251 aero brake levers for 23.8–24.2 mm handlebars. Reference hood colour is not specified.

technical_document.title: Shimano BL-A251 exploded view and replacement parts; standard lever model

sources.title: Shimano Dealers’ 1990 Product Manual, page 34: BL-A251 membership in Exage 300EX and 310 g pair weight; published August 1989 (archived by Disraeli Gears)
Shimano The New System Component Family for Every Riding Style, August 1988, page 10: BL-A251 listed for Exage Motion (archived by Disraeli Gears)

specifications.compatibility_notes: The 1989 dealer manual specifies SLR-compatible brakes and Shimano outer cable with a liner. BL-A251-EX with auxiliary extension levers is a separate model.
